memories.content: Neighbor A has been having ongoing disputes with Neighbor B over property boundaries and noise. A is frustrated and considering legal action but is open to reconciliation if B shows willingness.

The two neighbors live adjacent to each other in a suburban area. They have had several arguments in the past few months about property lines and noise from B's late-night gatherings. No formal complaints have been filed yet. Both are aware of the tension and have mutual acquaintances who might mediate.
